candidates.source_name: Česká bankovní asociace (ČBA) – Členové (member banks directory)
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative roster of ~34 banks and building societies covering >99% of the CZ banking sector. This is the canonical buyer-universe list for A2 tender monitoring: every entity here is a potential contracting entity (some are also sectoral/state-linked buyers) and the list lets us seed profile/entity resolution against tender portals. Note www.cbaonline.cz/o-nas/clenove also appears in search indexes as an alternative path.
candidates.legal_status: publicly published membership list; factual entity names not protected
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic HTML scrape of the members page (monthly), diff against stored roster to detect joins/exits; normalize to IČO via ARES for entity matching with tender portals
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs-language search on association name + 'seznam členů', then direct fetch of members page
queries_used: Česká bankovní asociace seznam členů banky
cbaonline.cz "členové" ČBA seznam bank asociace stránka

Useful as an early-warning layer around A2 tender signals rather than as a tender source itself. English content exists partially.
candidates.legal_status: press content, copyright applies to text; headline/link harvesting fine
candidates.suggested_collection_method: RSS if present else weekly HTML crawl of news listing; store title+date+URL only
candidates.discovered_via_method: site navigation observed while fetching ČBA pages

This is the highest-yield map of the CZ payments supplier long tail — i.e. our competitor and partner universe when reading award notices. Bilingual site (cs/en).

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a two-stage crawler: enumerate regional entities from komora.cz and SMO ČR, then apply per-site extraction templates; budget this as a medium-effort project, not a single scrape.

brief: Czech banking/payments associations are dense, well-organised and almost all publish open member directories in Czech, making this cell the cheapest available map of both the buyer side (ČBA ~34 banks, ČLFA ~35 leasing/consumer-finance firms, SBK card issuers/acquirers, AKAT, ČAP) and the supplier side (ICT UNIE ~60 ICT integrators, Czech Fintech Association 80+ fintech/payments vendors, APEK ~580 e-commerce and software firms). The single most on-topic body for workstream A2 is Asociace pro veřejné zakázky, which explicitly segments its members into zadavatelé, dodavatelé, administrátoři and law firms — a ready-made procurement role map — with SP ČR and Hospodářská komora acting as association-of-associations hubs for further snowballing. Critically, none of these associations publishes tender notices itself: their value is entity resolution and long-tail actor discovery feeding the portal-based tender cells, not primary notice collection. Main risks are URL instability (ČBA member-page paths 404 when guessed; AVZ uses legacy Joomla query-string routes), Czech-only rosters for most of the highest-value lists, and fragmentation of chamber and municipal membership across dozens of regional sites.
